raw.quick_view: VNINDEX giằng co quanh 1792, ngay duoi vung dinh cu 1798.79, cau truc D1/H4 van bullish nhung dang mat da trong bien do hep. BB Squeeze tren M15 bao hieu breakout sap toi nhung chua ro huong. Ưu tien quan sat, chua vao lenh moi cho toi khi co xac nhan breakout kem thanh khoan.
raw.market_context: VNINDEX dang test lai vung dinh gan nhat 1794-1798, sau chuoi tang tu vung 1747 (EMA200 D1). Gia hien tai (1792.54) nam tren EMA20/EMA50 D1 nhung cach dinh swing chi con ~6 diem, cho thay dia ban hep va rui ro T+2 neu vao muon. Thanh khoan phien sang tang (vol ratio 1.69) cho thay dong tien dang chu y nhung chua xac nhan huong ro rang do BB dang squeeze.

macro_catalysts.title: BB Squeeze tren M15 - Breakout Pending
macro_catalysts.detail: Bien do gia dang thu hep manh tren M15, thuong bao hieu bien dong manh sap xay ra ca 2 chieu, ket hop voi Vol Ratio cao 1.69 tang do tin cay tin hieu breakout

macro_catalysts.title: Phan ky momentum giua cac khung thoi gian
macro_catalysts.detail: D1/H4/H1 deu bullish nhung M15 va M5 cho thay MACD bearish, RSI M5 chi 50.31 trung tinh - canh bao suc mua ngan han dang yeu di khi tiep can vung can

raw.weekly_analysis: W1 trend Bullish, EMA Full Bullish Alignment xac nhan xu huong tang dai han van nguyen ven. Tuy nhien MACD W1 bearish cho thay dong luc tang dang cham lai o khung lon, can theo doi neu tiep tuc phan ky.
raw.d3_analysis: 3D dong pha voi W1: trend Bullish, EMA Full Bullish, nhung MACD cung bearish - cung co canh bao mat da tren khung trung han, phu hop voi bo cuc dang sideways gan dinh.
raw.daily_analysis: D1 RSI thuc te 55.49 (Bullish Zone nhung khong qua mua), MACD Hist duong 10.66 con ho tro xu huong tang. Gia dong cua 1792.54 dang Above EMA20 D1 (1767.37) va tren EMA50 D1 (1786.45), tren EMA200 D1 (1747.94) - cau truc tang gia vung chac ve mat vi tri gia so EMA. Tuy nhien EMA align ghi nhan Mixed, can luu y thu tu EMA chua hoan toan chuan bullish stacking, cho thay xu huong tang chua thuc su manh me, dang trong giai doan cung co.
raw.m15_analysis: M15 cho thay cau truc Range/Mixed voi BB Squeeze - tin hieu breakout dang chuan bi. EMA Alignment Full Bullish nhung MACD bias lai Bearish va momentum Neutral/Compressing - day la dau hieu can trong, luc mua ngan han dang yeu dan du xu huong tong the con tang. Volume cao ho tro kha nang breakout that su thay vi false signal, nhung chua co candle pattern xac nhan ro rang.
raw.money_flow: Dong tien dang tap trung o nhom co von hoa lon do Vol Ratio phien sang tang manh 1.69 lan so trung binh, tuy nhien chua the khang dinh la dong tien lan toa hay chi keo tru vi thieu du lieu breadth chi tiet. Voi vung gia sat dinh cu, kha nang dong tien dang tham do truoc khi quyet dinh xu huong breakout.

avoid: Nhom penny thanh khoan thap da tang nong truoc do

raw.institutional_view: Khoi ngoai va dong tien lon nhieu kha nang dang trong trang thai quan sat truoc vung can quan trong, chua co du lieu cu the ve mua/ban rong nen can than trong khi danh gia. Neu ho tro luc breakout qua 1798, xac suat xu huong tang tiep tuc cao hon; nguoc lai neu khoi ngoai ban rong tai day se tang rui ro dieu chinh.
raw.retail_view: Nha dau tu ca nhan co the dang FOMO mua duoi tai vung khang cu do gia da tang manh tu day 1747, nhung day chinh la vung nguy hiem de mua duoi neu khong co xac nhan breakout ro rang - de kep margin neu gia dao chieu giam sau khi cham can.
